description: Publish an immutable version from the exact expected draft revision. Requires confirmPublish=true and an idempotency key. Authoring gate (DEV-3198): fails closed with AUTHORING_CONTRADICTION (400) for non-acknowledgeable errors and AUTHORING_ACK_REQUIRED (409) until every remaining acknowledgeable warning is acknowledged in THIS call by the exact acknowledgement (code + moduleKey + lessonKey + current contentHash from opentrain_lms_validate_course; later edits invalidate it). Acknowledgements are never persisted. Publishing does not change existing learner assignments: after publishing, call opentrain_lms_rollout_preview and then opentrain_lms_rollout_course_version to apply the release safely.

items.description: One request-scoped acknowledgement: the exact tuple a validate finding carries (its acknowledgementId is code:moduleKey:lessonKey:contentHash).

completionPolicy.description: Optional request override. INDIVIDUAL_MASTERY requires SYSTEM. Assignment records remain authoritative for delivery.

idempotencyKey.description: Required request idempotency key. Reuse it only for the identical operation.

validationIntent.description: Optional request override. When omitted, validation uses the canonical draft authoringIntent or the legacy STANDARD default.

name: opentrain_lms_publish_course
